shortDescription: Russian aluminium giant Rusal RUS:RUAL is working on a project to build a bauxite and alumina complex in Indonesia to strengthen its raw material supply, it said on Friday.

children: is working on a project to build a bauxite and alumina complex in Indonesia to strengthen its raw material supply, it said on Friday.
A day earlier, Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto told the Eastern Economic Forum in Russia that Rusal planned to build facilities in the country together with Indonesian companies.
"The Indonesian project represents a continuation of the company's diversification strategy in the Pacific region," a company representative said.
Rusal, the world's largest aluminium producer outside China, has explored opportunities in Indonesia before without managing to move tentative projects forward.
Although it has not been targeted by Western sanctions, it has sought to reduce its reliance on third-party suppliers of alumina, a raw material needed for aluminium production.
It lost around 40% of its alumina supplies from Ukraine and Australia in 2022.
A metals industry source in Indonesia told Reuters in 2024 that Rusal had registered a local company as it was again considering building a bauxite and alumina complex in the country.
In 2025, Rusal produced 6.858 million tons of alumina, accounting for 4.7% of global output and 85% of the company's alumina requirements.
